before.question: Who is eligible to receive the complete Envoys factory output: must the single recipient have an envoy token, or may Zeth give that output to a player without one?
before.expected_answer: The one recipient must have an envoy token; a player without one is not eligible.

required_facts.fact: The single recipient of Envoys factory output must have an envoy token; a player without one is ineligible

before.novelty: Factory recipient eligibility, distinct from grouping, gift refusal and theft discounts

after.question: May Zeth send the Envoys factory resources to a player alone, or must an envoy token accompany those resources to the same player when they are traded or gifted?
after.expected_answer: An envoy token must accompany all Envoys factory resources to the same player when traded or gifted; do not send the resources alone.

required_facts.fact: An envoy token must be sent along with all Envoys factory resources to the same player when traded or gifted

after.novelty: Mandatory accompanying envoy-token transfer with factory resources, distinct from output grouping, spare-token trade permission and theft discounts

reason: Original printed Zeth Envoys says resources are traded/gifted to same player along with an envoy token. Recipient prior possession is not the rule. Root native-source correction before fresh readers; prior bank remains immutable.
source: Original Zeth front Envoys first paragraph
